notes: ANTS 2014, published under “A sieve algorithm based on overlattices”; first ePrint 24 October 2013. A tower of overlattices and translated cosets replaces a single-lattice sieve. The stated decimal coefficients are rounded: time 0.3774 and memory 0.2925. Analysis depends on the Gaussian heuristic, rather than an arbitrary-lattice correctness theorem.

extra.heuristic: Gaussian heuristic for intermediate overlattices and cosets
